edges.reason: delegate gates execution on msg.sender == owner, caller-controlled authorization
init requires msg.sender == owner to set sale parameters
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing balances
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner to set tradeAddress
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints balance to caller
transferFrom branches on msg.sender != _from and consumes caller allowance
_from parameter drives balance/allowance lookups in transferFrom
_to parameter receives credited balance in transferFrom
_value flows into unchecked subtraction of allowance and balance in transferFrom
Parameter a becomes the target address of the delegatecall
Parameter b becomes the raw calldata of the delegatecall
delegate function invokes the unsafe a.delegatecall(b) operation
Arbitrary delegatecall can re-enter transferFrom and manipulate balanceOf/allowance state
_value multiplies with array length without overflow protection in batchSend
_tos.length feeds the unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length
batchSend performs the unchecked multiplication of total
Local total is the result of the unchecked multiplication
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance and balance subtractions
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before state mutation

ensure reads canSale[_from] whitelist flag
ensure reads tradeAddress whitelist
ensure reads owner whitelist address

condition reads _saleNum limit

init writes _maxSale derived from maxToken parameter

maxToken parameter scales into _maxSale in init
addr parameter written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress
loop index i controls the batchSend distribution loop
loop-local _to receives _value credited inside batchSend
constructor writes owner state variable

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only consumed by transferFrom balance/allowance logic
_to is only consumed by the transferFrom recipient bookkeeping
_value drives the unchecked subtraction operation invoked by transferFrom
parameter a is the target of the unsafe delegatecall
parameter b is the raw data of the unsafe delegatecall
addr is written directly into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress
token only feeds _minSale assignment in init
maxToken only feeds _maxSale assignment in init
_tos.length is an operand of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend
_value is the other operand of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend
total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication
i is only the loop counter inside batchSend
_to is only a per-iteration recipient in the batchSend loop
